mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month indicates a weakening labor market, which negatively impacts consumer spending and thus S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of periods following two consecutive quarters of GDP decline.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds the historical average by more than 1%, it indicates a tightening monetary policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% YoY signals a strengthening demand in the housing sector, which positively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in one month signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) decreases by more than 1% MoM, it indicates supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) and retail sales (RSAFS) both increase by more than 2% YoY, it signals a strong economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.
